intro.text: A listener lieutenant serving under Eshonai.

items.text: Varanis was among the soldiers painting in the Hall of Art in an attempt to attract creationspren, and Eshonai chuckled at his game efforts to paint flowers in warform.
After Eshonai took stormform, Varanis was among those chosen to transform in the next storm. When Thude and a group of dissenters fled into the chasms, he reported it to her, angering her.
Rlain knew Varanis, and mourned him among the listeners he had lost.

personality.text: Varanis is a disciplined, loyal soldier and one of Eshonai's most trusted lieutenants.
